evalbot: ALERT: nightly-eval run 'nightly-2026-03-18' flagged abnormal regressions for model redwood-alpha-v2-q8. Metrics: toxicity_score=0.47 (+0.35 vs baseline), repetition_loop_rate +8.2% vs yesterday. Affected prompt buckets: medical-guidance, legal-qa, chat-assistant. Samples attached.
maya: got it, thanks. @sam can you pick this up? did anything from the quant sweep land on the nightly pool yesterday?
sam: i'm on it. quick glance: we auto-promoted a q8 config yesterday (per-channel asymmetric). repro run id repro-20260318-01 queued. Running reproducer now. command i'm using:
```
./run_eval.sh --model redwood-alpha-v2-q8 --promptset medical-guidance --seed 42 --save-examples repro-20260318-01
```
eli: pasted two worst outputs here — both show short token loops and a fabricated citation: 
1) "...the patient should undergo surgery surgery surgery — see Dr. Reynolds, JAMA 2020"
2) "...contract requires payment in the amount of $X,000.00 $X,000.00 $X,000.00"
Both also include confident-sounding but false facts.
linh: hmmm reminds me of the int4 longctx regression we saw last month. What are the sequence lengths for these prompts?
sam: avg seq_len ~1200 tokens, p95 ~3500 tokens for the medical set. I see runtime warnings in the repro logs: 
```
[2026-03-18T02:01:12Z] WARNING kernel: attention_v2 not available, falling back to attention_fallback
[2026-03-18T02:01:12Z] WARNING quant: scale_rounding_mismatch for layer 17
[2026-03-18T02:01:13Z] NOTE kv_cache: disabled due to low memory on instance
```
maya: ok assign P1. @sam + @eli: reproduce locally w/ fp16 baseline + q8. Try kv_cache enabled/disabled. Add tracing on attention kernels. If repro, rollback q8 auto-promo from nightly pool and re-enable fp16 for the nightly run until we root cause.
sam: running local fp16 vs q8 now. also will test with kv_cache forced on. ETA ~30m.
eli: i'll run focused small-batch tests to isolate tokenization/control-char triggers. i'll also diff tokenizer outputs vs yesterday.
evalbot: UPDATE repro-20260318-01 finished. Repro status: LOOP reproduced on q8 with kv_cache disabled (loop_rate +9.1%). With kv_cache enabled, loop_rate falls to +0.8% (near baseline). Toxicity_score also drops from 0.47 -> 0.13 with kv_cache on. Attached sample outputs and kernel traces.
linh: interesting. If kv_cache toggles the behaviour, was there an infra change? maybe cold-start/memory裁剪?
sam: digging infra logs — i see autoscaler cold-start jobs in the nightly pool that select smaller instance type to speed up spin-up. Those runtimes disable kv_cache to save memory. entry: /deploy/jobs/coldstart-rls: "use-small-instance=true". Opening infra ticket infra-1234.
maya: concrete next steps: 1) immediate: set nightly pool to prefer instances that support kv_cache (revert cold-start override), 2) revert auto-promotion of q8 to nightly until we confirm quant scale fix, 3) add a unit in nightly eval that runs both kv_cache on/off to catch divergence, 4) add a short smoke test for kernel fallback presence. @sam @eli please file PRs for 1 & 2.
sam: created PR #4523 to re-enable kv_cache defaults for nightly pool. PR #4524 created to pause q8 auto-promotion.
eli: i'll add a harness test that runs a tiny medical prompt set with kv_cache toggled and fails the build if loop delta > 2%. will open PR for eval harness after I confirm local patch.
linh: i'll also add an infra alert if instances chosen for nightly pool report kv_cache disabled.
maya: perfect. i'll notify release and infra channels and schedule a quick rollback window if needed. thanks team. :thumbsup:
sam: quick note — there's also a small quant scale rounding fix merged yesterday (commit 0a1b2c). if re-enabling q8 later, test with that fix.
eli: noted. will include regression test for scale_rounding_mismatch.
maya: update in 1h or when PRs merged.
(reacts: maya :eyes:, sam :hammer:, eli :white_check_mark:)
